record.original_question: For each fixed integer k>2, is the decision problem that takes a graph G as input and asks whether the list packing number χ⋆ℓ(G) is at most k complete for the complexity class Π^P_2?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.10 Fix k > 2. Given a graph G as input, is the problem of deciding whether χ⋆ ℓ(G)≤k complete for the complexity class Π P 2?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a finite simple graph. A list assignment of size $k$ on $G$ is a function $L$ that assigns to each vertex $v\in V$ a set $L(v)$ with $|L(v)|=k$. A proper $L$-coloring of $G$ is a function $c:V\to\bigcup_v L(v)$ such that $c(v)\in L(v)$ for all $v\in V$ and $c(u)\neq c(v)$ whenever $uv\in E$. A list packing of size $k$ for $G$ with respect to $L$ is a collection $c_1,\dots,c_k$ of proper $L$-colorings of $G$ such that for every vertex $v\in V$ the values $c_1(v),\dots,c_k(v)$ are pairwise distinct (i.e., they form a permutation of $L(v)$). The list packing number $\chi^\star_\ell(G)$ is the least integer $k$ such that for every list assignment $L$ on $G$ with $|L(v)|=k$ for all $v$, a list packing of size $k$ exists.

Fix an integer $k>2$. Consider the decision problem: given a finite simple graph $G$ as input, decide whether $\chi^\star_\ell(G)\le k$. Is this decision problem complete for the complexity class $\Pi_2^P$ (the second level of the polynomial hierarchy)?
artifact.status_search_result: The list packing number was introduced around 2021, and the precise computational complexity of deciding whether $\chi^\star_\ell(G)\le k$ does not appear to have been resolved. While analogous results are known (choosability and group list-coloring are $\Pi_2^P$-complete), no published proof of $\Pi_2^P$-completeness for list packing was found. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: List packing number of bounded degree graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the list packing number, a recent notion in graph coloring.
status_evidence.claim: List packing is a recently introduced graph parameter under active study.

status_evidence.title: Group coloring is Π_2^P-complete
status_evidence.snippet: Group list coloring shown Π_2^P-complete by Kráľ.
status_evidence.claim: Related list-coloring variants are known to be Π_2^P-complete, but list packing's status is not similarly established.
